summary: Buenaventura filed a Form 6-K announcing its second-quarter 2026 production and sales results for metals including gold, silver, lead, zinc, and copper. The report provides production volumes by mine, updated 2026 guidance, and average realized prices. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine periodic operational update, not a special-situation event.
